set.body: A new lifecycle test accidentally returned a lazy IO under StudioFxSuite/FunSuite and appeared green without running. MUnit documents this behavior for unsupported lazy effect values. Add a harness value transform that rejects returned cats.effect.IO with an actionable failure, without executing it after fixture cleanup. Verify normal transformer refusal and an actual FX fixture expected-failure canary; mutate/remove the guard and prove the canaries fail. Full native gate must expose any other affected existing tests. Do not reinterpret the invalid intermediate lifecycle greens as execution evidence.
set.title: Refuse unevaluated IO returned by native FX tests
